messages:
Kevin: Heads-up — planning to enable the multi-region failover FF for model rdx-neo-1. Canary to 5% traffic in eu-west, fallback route -> us-east when latency > 300ms for 2 consecutive requests. Asking infra + oncall: any blockers?

Maya: Quick Qs before we flip: 1) what does stickiness look like? 2) how do we handle KV cache keys across regions? 3) preferred canary window/time?

Kevin: Stickiness plan: hash(session_id) -> region, sticky_ttl = 24h by default. KV cache keys should include region suffix unless we want global shared cache (but that hurts cold starts). Canary window proposal: 04:00 UTC (low traffic) for 2h.

Jon: For stickiness we need to ensure rollout doesn't break existing session affinity. Suggest: if user already pinned to a region, keep them there unless that region is unhealthy. Add `sticky_ttl` opt-out for internal tests. Also will add region tag to cache keys (`{cache_key}::region`).

Sarah: Oncall checklist: create alerts + dashboards. P95 latency target for rdx-neo-1 should be <= 300ms. Guardrail alert: p95 > 400ms for 3m OR error_rate > 1% for 5m auto-disable FF. Also watch model mismatch/regression signals.

Kevin: Good. I'll add an auto-disable rule: disable after 3 incidents in 30m (incident = guardrail alert). Also exclude enterprise customers from canary (acct.tier == "enterprise").

Maya: Please emit trace tag `feature:multi_region_failover` and `ff.canary=true` for canary requests so we can filter traces quickly.

Jon: I'll open a tiny config PR: routing policy + cache key change + sticky ttl config. Will include a deploy checklist and a migration note. Ping me if CI flakes.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: featureflag rdx.multi_region_failover scheduled: start=1763457600 (04:00 UTC), canary_pct=5, exclude_segments=["enterprise"], auto_disable=true

Kevin: Thanks — plan is: 04:00 UTC start -> 2h canary -> 25% for 1h -> full if no alerts. If auto-disable triggers, I'll create a rollback runbook.

Sarah: Confirmed monitoring + oncall coverage for that window. I'll set up a short runbook in the incident channel and handy dashboards.

Maya: LGTM. Once Jon's PR is up, drop the link here and I'll review the sticky logic. :thumbsup:

Jon: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/routing/pull/482 (WIP) — adding tests and config. Expect CI by EOD.

Kevin: Perfect. Leaving this thread pinned for the rollout window. If anything changes, ping @oncall and update the flag schedule.

Sarah: Also note: add a synthetic traffic job to hit eu-west quantized variant so cache warms fast during canary.

Kevin: Will do. Thanks everyone.
